query: query WindowPullRequests($owner: String!, $name: String!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { list: pullRequests(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { number title state isDraft updatedAt baseRefName body mergeCommit { oid } repository { nameWithOwner defaultBranchRef { name } } closingIssuesReferences(first: 100) { nodes { number repository { nameWithOwner } } } author { login } assignees(first: 20) { nodes { login } } reviewRequests(first: 100) { nodes { requestedReviewer { ... on User { login } ... on Bot { login } } } } latestReviews(first: 100) { nodes { author { login } state } } lastCommit: commits(last: 1) { nodes { commit { statusCheckRollup { state } } } } commits(first: 100) { totalCount nodes { commit { message parents { totalCount } committer { user { login } } } } } } } } rateLimit { remaining resetAt } }
